project: Wuxia Life P64 Merchant Magnate Differentiated Pressure And Payoff
description: Add the smallest bounded differentiation inside magnate_midlife_pressure and magnate_payoff so the three ordinary-origin merchant ascents remain distinct beyond entry, while preserving the shared P55 magnate chain and avoiding a full merchant second-wave buildout.

userStories.title: Audit pressure and payoff flattening
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want an audit of where the three merchant entries still flatten back into one shared magnate experience so P64 solves the real mid/late-stage gap.
acceptanceCriteria: Summarize the currently shared parts of magnate_midlife_pressure and magnate_payoff
Separate shared unified magnate identity from flattening that weakens route differentiation
Save docs/test-reports/p64-merchant-pressure-payoff-flattening-audit.md
Do not change runtime behavior in this story

userStories.title: Lock P64 scope contract
userStories.description: As a planner, I want a scope contract so P64 stays a bounded densification stage rather than growing into a new merchant content wave.
acceptanceCriteria: Limit P64 to pressure and payoff differentiation only
Define allowed layers: light configuration, expression, proof, and narrow tests
List forbidden expansions: large new chains, new systems, and a full merchant universe buildout
Save docs/test-reports/p64-merchant-pressure-payoff-scope-contract.md

userStories.title: Define differentiated pressure contracts
userStories.description: As a designer, I want bounded pressure contracts for apprentice, tavern, and peasant merchant ascents so their burdens do not read identically.
acceptanceCriteria: Define at least three pressure-emphasis contracts, one per bridge path
Tie each pressure contract to its origin-to-merchant path instead of generic merchant stress
Keep the shared merchant_magnate mixed identity intact
Record the contracts in the PRD or appendix

userStories.title: Define differentiated payoff contracts
userStories.description: As a designer, I want bounded payoff contracts so the three merchant entries land with different emphases rather than one undifferentiated merchant success line.
acceptanceCriteria: Define at least three payoff-emphasis contracts, one per bridge path
Make each payoff reflect a different source-of-gain emphasis from the earlier path
Keep the payoff distinct from merchant_martial_patron, generic merchant success, and the P55 baseline payoff
Record the contracts in the PRD or appendix

userStories.title: Wire pressure and payoff differentiation
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the differentiated pressure/payoff implemented through bounded configuration or marker changes so the main magnate chain remains intact.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement differentiation only through existing magnate carriers or light markers
Do not introduce a new merchant framework
Keep the existing P55 magnate chain stably triggerable
Existing P55, P58, P59, P61, and P63 evidence does not regress

userStories.title: Add differentiated merchant expression
userStories.description: As a player, I want the three magnate ascents to read differently once they reach pressure and payoff phases.
acceptanceCriteria: Add at least three readable pressure/payoff-specific signals across existing expression surfaces
Make apprentice, tavern, and peasant mid/late-stage merchant burdens or payoffs distinguishable
Do not add new UI components
Add or update focused expression tests

userStories.title: Add targeted differentiated proof
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a bounded proof artifact showing that the three merchant ascents now diverge meaningfully in mid/late-stage emphasis.
acceptanceCriteria: Produce one comparison-style targeted proof artifact
Show pressure or payoff differentiation contrasts across the three bridge paths
Do not require full merchant combinatorial exhaust
Ensure the proof can be compared against the P55 baseline magnate chain

userStories.title: Add narrow regression coverage
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want narrow tests guarding the differentiated pressure/payoff so future edits do not collapse the merchant trilogy back into one path.
acceptanceCriteria: Cover markers, player-facing expression, and comparison-level assertions with narrow checks
Reuse existing merchant and bridge harnesses
Do not rewrite the full merchant test suite
Relevant commands pass

userStories.title: Produce P64 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report stating exactly what post-entry merchant differentiation now exists and what remains deferred.
acceptanceCriteria: Save docs/test-reports/p64-merchant-pressure-payoff-differentiation-closure-report.md
Summarize the flattening audit, contracts, configuration, expression, proof, and tests
State the boundary versus any future full merchant wave
List larger economy, map, or new-destiny items that remain deferred
